arabic text: Dukhtar e shahe lafata zainab\nApni manzil ki fatema zainab
english translation text: Zainab, daughter of the Lion of God;\nZainab, Fatima upon the path to her destination.

arabic text: Koi samjhega tujhko kya zainab\nTujhpe shabbir the fida zainab
english translation text: Who could ever truly understand you, Zainab?\nShabbir himself was devoted to you, Zainab.

arabic text: Yeh tha bas tera hosla zainab\nTujhse zinda hai karbala zainab
english translation text: This was your courage alone, Zainab;\nthrough you, Karbala remains alive, Zainab.

arabic text: Deene islam ki bina the hussain\nDeen islam ki baqaa zainab
english translation text: Hussain was the foundation of Islam;\nZainab became the preservation of Islam.

arabic text: Fatehe jange karbala shabir\nFatahe jange har bala zainab
english translation text: Shabbir was the victor of the battle of Karbala;\nZainab was the victor over every calamity.

arabic text: Tu thi dunya me sanie zahra\nTera sani na ho saka zainab
english translation text: In this world, you were the second Zahra;\nnone could ever become your equal, Zainab.

arabic text: Naam bayat yazeed le na saka\nTora yoon tune hosla zainab
english translation text: Yazid could not even speak of allegiance;\nyou shattered his courage in this way, Zainab.

arabic text: Tere dam se hai aaj dunya me\nMatam e shah e karbala zainb
english translation text: Through you, the mourning of the King of Karbala\nremains alive in the world today, Zainab.

arabic text: Bad shabbir ab baraaye kaleem\nHai faqat tera aasraa zainab
english translation text: After Shabbir, O "Kaleem",\nZainab alone is our support.
